pk.context: 56 mg nasal, single dose, healthy adults

tell: The S-enantiomer of ketamine, given as a nasal spray with at least two hours of monitoring after each dose.

clues.text: Mean absolute bioavailability is about 48% after nasal spray, and it is 43% to 45% protein bound. It is cleared mainly by cytochrome P450 metabolism, with metabolites recovered mostly in urine.
A hydrochloride salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 237.72. It is freely soluble in water.
An NDA product of 28 mg per device, sold in 56 mg and 84 mg dose kits.
Boxed warning for sedation, dissociation, respiratory depression and abuse. Contraindicated with intracerebral hemorrhage or aneurysmal vascular disease; dissociation and dizziness are common.
Treatment-resistant depression in adults, alone or with an oral antidepressant, and depressive symptoms with acute suicidal ideation in major depressive disorder.
It is a non-selective, non-competitive antagonist of the NMDA receptor, an ionotropic glutamate receptor. The mechanism of its antidepressant effect is unknown.
The generic name begins with E and has ten letters.
